why_these_outcomes_exist.HIGH-1: Same as the host-attribute-axis file: the cycle-1 prose prescribed an abbreviated wrapper that was never the rule measured. B-abbrev is added here too, so #307's frozen contract and #309's generator are pinned against the same evidence for both construct kinds rather than only for one.
why_these_outcomes_exist.MEDIUM-2: This sheet has no unconditional @container rule, so the app-shell gap does not exist here — its single 400px breakpoint IS exercised by the cycle-1 states (360 below, 500 above). What the cycle-1 set never touched is the boundary itself. `@container (max-width: 400px)` is inclusive, so 400 must reflow and 401 must not; a generator that emitted `<` for `<=` would have passed the cycle-1 table.

static_exemplar_variants_added.B-abbrev: `.sk-action-row-host { container-type: inline-size }` and nothing else — the wrapper as the cycle-1 prose prescribed it.
